Fixtures for the 2025–26 season were announced on 8 August 2025.{{cite web |url=https://ligikuu.co.tz/first-league/season-2025-2026/ |title=RATIBA YA LIGI DARAJA LA KWANZA MSIMU WA 2025/2026|last1=Board |first1=TPLB |date=12 September 2025|publisher=[[Tanzania Premier League Board|TPLB]]|access-date=18 November 2025}} ==Format== The league consists of 16 teams and divided into two groups.
